front: Link your life to an ally, healing them and absorbing some of the damage they take at the cost of your own HP.
back:
On Cast, target recovers 1d4 HP. First time each round target takes damage, reduce it by 3 (min 0); you lose 3 HP each time (or the damage dealt if less); this ignores your immunities and resistances and can't be mitigated. Ends if you fall unconscious. Can Dismiss.
Heightened (3rd): 2 targets, 3d4 healing, max 5.
(6th): 3 targets, 6d4, max 10.
(9th): 4 targets, 9d4, max 15.
